503.description: Database is unavailable or migration ledger cannot be read.

401.description: Invalid credentials, disabled account, or invalid session state.
Refresh token is missing, expired, revoked, or already rotated.

204.description: Candidate session revoked and cookie cleared.
Organization membership removed; global user account is retained.

200.description: Provider-neutral realtime media readiness. No credentials are returned.
Consent, release and provider readiness for a realtime media session.
Persist a media lifecycle session after a successful preflight.
Issue a short-lived room-scoped LiveKit token for a synthetic/internal candidate. Token is never persisted.
Stream WAV synthesized only from the persisted finalized Interview Brain spoken_text. No client-supplied text is accepted.
Latest persisted media lifecycle state for the interview session.
Provider-neutral participant lifecycle state without credentials or raw media.
Idempotently append an operational media event without raw media, transcript text or credentials.
